propositions: Author-facing guides must be rewritten to reflect the collapsed SC/AC vocabulary, removing all references to Success Criteria as a distinct heading requirement separate from Acceptance Criteria.

The leaf-vs-container section guidance must be re-expressed to describe container requirements as decomposition/coverage (children must cover acceptance criteria) and deferred testing to children, rather than prescribing a Success Criteria heading.

grep scan for success criteria vocabulary in src/rebar/_guides/, docs/user-guide.md, and docs/llm-framework.md must return zero matches, excluding four permanent carve-outs (plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier variants, and dod_uncertifiable field).
rebar explain plan command must exit 0 and render output containing no Success Criteria vocabulary after the guide update.
